site_name: Proposed Telecommunication Mast Id 14710 On Pavement South Of 156 To 158
application_type_full: Prior Approval: Development for electronic communications network
description: Determination as to whether prior approval is required for the removal of 1no existing 8 metre lamppost with 2no antennas and 3no equipment cabinets at the junction of Warriner Gardens and Beechmore Road, Battersea, and the installation of 1no 20 metre monopole with 6no antennas, 1no wraparound cabinet, 3no equipment cabinets and associated ancillary works on the pavement on the south of 156 to 158 Battersea Park Road.
decision_conditions: Reason : 1 - The proposed 20m tall telecommunications mast, by reason of its design, appearance and siting would represent a visually obtrusive and discordant form of development that would have a harmful impact on the character and appearance of the streetscene and surrounding area. The proposal would therefore not meet with the relevant conditions attached to Class A of Part 16 of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order and would be contrary to the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), policy SI6 of the London Plan (2021) and policies LP1 and LP22 of the Wandsworth Local Plan (2023).
